differences.what: composition: the front square-on, the canted bay at its north end, the cornice over the chamber windows' hoods, the door under a porch right of the middle with a broad high stoop before it and iron fences either side of the walk; built so
the corner bay rising past the main cornice under a cornice of its own: built, but the camera's frame cuts it at the panel's top edge, so only its lower storeys show

the porch: the sketch draws a round arch springing between paired columns across a porch wider than the stoop, with a balustrade over it. T-3283 builds the arch (0.8 m rise), the balustrade and the elevation's 4.9 m width, and stands the columns in pairs, two shafts at each end of the porch 0.8 m apart (columns.at_v_m), the arch turned only over the wide span between the pairs (arches.over) and the spandrel whole over each pair, as the sketch draws them either side of the door

the stoop's cheeks: the sketch's stone cheek walls sweep out and down to round-capped stone posts at the walk; T-3283 builds K07's swept cheeks flared 0.6 m out each side to a newel under a cap and a round knob (in this camera they stand behind the gate's piers)

the fence: the sketch's panels of large S-scrolls between posts either side of the walk, no pickets. T-3283 builds K11's scroll-panel fence: bars at bays of at most 0.4 m (two scrolls to the sketch's post-to-post span of about 0.8 m), a tall S of the kit's scroll bar in each bay, every other one mirrored, so the render's panels read as scrolls, not railings. The sketch's scrolls curl rounder and its posts carry balls where the kit's carry acorns: under the bar, within the pen sketch's own freehand

heights: the sketch's principal storey is drawn about 1.3 times taller for its width than the record's (the camera's pixel aspect 0.779 and 11.9 px RMS); the storeys' order and the windows' places agree
colour and material: a pen sketch, hatched in courses; the record's brick colour is the kit's
the chamber windows' sills, the principal windows' heads and the porch's upper part are behind the numerals' cartouche

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
